pls-love.quote: PLS Love stays at No. 1, and Lena and Miu have made me love them more than ever.

juliet-and-juliet.quote: A modest budget, an Asian mafia story and two young women caught in the middle. Say what you will: I’m still enjoying Juliet & Juliet far more than I expected.

third-person.quote: I’m loving Third Person more and more, even with YouTube being my viewing route here in America. After episode six, we’re beginning to untangle this mystery, but I still have no idea how it will end.

khom-khlang.quote: I know plenty of people love it, and I admire the way light and shadow paint the scenes. Visually, it can be brilliant. For me, though, it’s just boring.

fairway-of-love.quote: For me, the casting is where this show falls apart. […] Ing Tanatcha deserves a word of her own. There’s an assurance to her performance that makes me want to see more of her.
